players.product: AI server and switch system integration

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration: top 10 customers represented 79% of total revenue for 2025, 73% for 2024 and 64% for 2023. In 2025 three customers, all in the CCS segment, individually represented 10% or more of total revenue (32%, 14% and 12%); in 2024 two CCS customers (28% and 11%); in 2023 one CCS customer (22%). The customers are not named.

CCS segment revenue for fiscal year 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 was $9.19B (+41.6% YoY vs $6.49B) and represented 74% of consolidated revenue. Communications end market revenue increased 81% driven by data center networking demand including ramping switch programs; HPS revenue increased 81% to $5.0 billion (41% of total 2025 revenue) on accelerating volumes in ramping networking switch programs with hyperscaler customers; Enterprise end market revenue decreased 19% driven by a technology transition in an AI/ML compute program with one hyperscaler customer.
